images.alt: Blue square that reads: migraine matters. nearly 1 in 7 NZ adults experience migraine symptoms. An image shows 7 people, with one person coloured red to represent the statistics. The new zealand government and ministry of health logos are at the bottom of the square.

post.text:
Migraine affects many Kiwis, impacting work, family life, and wellbeing. 
New data shows that 628,000 adults experience migraine symptoms. 
Learn more: www.health.govt.nz/publications... #NZHealthSurvey #Migraine
